answer: The bug was in `OccupiedEntry::swap_indices` where the condition for swapping indices was incorrectly set to `if self.index == other`. This meant the swap only attempted to execute when the indices were already identical (and effectively did nothing or failed), and skipped execution when they were different, which is when a swap is actually needed. Changing the condition to `if self.index != other` fixes the issue.
